column1: # reflection object traversal adapters - EC-7 family C, declared on this directory's page
# RESTRICTED to the body sizes that carry the shared idiom. The tag chose the
# candidates; the bytes chose the members.
# Shape: two variants of one idiom: 188 at 46 B traverse the object directly; 110 at 75-76 B add a member offset with a null guard and differ only in that offset immediate.
#   0063E2C0 (29 B) takes a DYNAMIC offset from the class descriptor at [rcx+0xF4] rather than a constant; it is a different idiom and is excluded
# NOT dispositioned: the shared implementations these members jump or call into, and
# whatever object or member each adapter names.
# One function entry address per line, VA (image base 0x00120000 included).
